def answer_man_in_green_sweater(image):
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    if not man_patches:
        return "No man found."
    
    green_sweater_patches = [patch for patch in man_patches if patch.verify_property("sweater", "green")]
    if not green_sweater_patches:
        return "No man wearing a green sweater found."
    
    man_in_green_sweater_patch = max(green_sweater_patches, key=lambda patch: patch.compute_depth())
    description = man_in_green_sweater_patch.simple_query("Describe the man.")
    location = man_in_green_sweater_patch.llm_query(f"In what city is this man located?", long_answer=False)
    
    return f"The man in a green sweater is described as {description} and is located in {location}."

    camera_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in camera_patches]

    closest_distance = float('inf')
    target_girl_patch = None

    for girl_center in girl_centers:
        for camera_center in camera_centers:
            dx = abs(girl_center[0] - camera_center[0])
            dy = abs(girl_center[1] - camera_center[1])
            distance_squared = dx * dx + dy * dy
            if distance_squared < closest_distance:
                closest_distance = distance_squared
                target_girl_patch = girl_patches[girl_centers.index(girl_center)]

    return target_girl_patch
